description: Source code implementing the LOLWUT command for Redis, generating graphical ASCII art using Unicode braille characters, including functions for drawing and rendering a procedural art piece called 'Schotter'.

methods.name: lwTranslatePixelsGroup
methods.description: Converts a byte representing 8 pixel states into a UTF-8 braille character.

methods.name: lwDrawSchotter
methods.description: Generates a procedural abstract art canvas called 'Schotter' with randomized rotations and translations.

methods.name: renderCanvas
methods.description: Converts the canvas into a UTF-8 string with braille characters for terminal display.

methods.name: lolwut5Command
methods.description: Handles the LOLWUT command, parsing arguments, generating art, and sending the output.
